fields.label: Bezeichnung
fields.description: Internal label for this category sync, e.g. 'Main shop / products'. Internal-only.

fields.label: Zielsystem
fields.description: Shop platform the categories are mirrored into.

fields.label: Aktiv (am Cron-Sync teilnehmen)
fields.description: When enabled: the scheduled background job syncs this category sync regularly (cron). When disabled: runs only when 'Sync now' is clicked manually.

fields.label: Storefront
fields.description: Shopware storefront UUID. Suggestions loaded from 'Shopware Setting → Available Storefronts'. If no backend-root id is set, the storefront's navigation category is used as the root.

fields.label: Storefront (Medusa)
fields.description: Suggestions loaded from 'Medusa Setting → Available Storefronts'. Informational only — Medusa has no per-storefront categorisation, the value is ignored by the sync.

fields.label: Root
fields.description: Which ERPNext item group is the mirror's starting point, and which backend category corresponds to it.

fields.label: Root item group
fields.description: The mirror starts here and follows every sub-item-group. The root's 'exclude from category sync' flag is ignored.

fields.label: Backend root category ID
fields.description: UUID of the existing backend category to use as root. Leave empty to create it — derived from the storefront automatically on first sync.

fields.label: Sync empty leaf categories
fields.description: When disabled: leaf item-groups without items are skipped. When enabled: empty leaf categories are created in the shop too.

fields.label: Orphan categories
fields.description: What to do with backend categories under the root that no longer match any ERPNext item group. Keep = leave alone. Report only = list in the preview but don't delete. Delete (dangerous) = auto-delete in the shop — caution with manually-maintained categories!

fields.label: Name templates
fields.description: Optional Jinja templates controlling how ERPNext item groups are named and described in the shop.

fields.label: Name template
fields.description: Jinja template for the backend category name. Default {{ item_group.item_group_name }} uses the item-group name as-is.

fields.label: Description template
fields.description: Optional Jinja template for the backend category description.

fields.label: Manuelle Zuordnungen pro Artikelgruppe
fields.description: Special cases: map specific item groups to a specific backend category or exclude them from the sync.

fields.label: Node overrides
fields.description: Manual overrides per item group (pin a backend UUID or exclude the item group entirely).

fields.label: Status (informativ)
fields.description: Read-only status info from the last sync. Informational only.

fields.label: Status
fields.description: Aktueller Status des Syncs.

fields.label: Letzte Synchronisation (informativ)
fields.description: Timestamp of the last successful sync run.

fields.label: Letzter Heartbeat (informativ)
fields.description: Updated at the start of every sync attempt. Stale-mirror-recover removes rows stuck in 'running' for too long.

fields.label: Last error message (informational)
fields.description: Short summary of the most recent error. Full stacktrace in the Ecommerce Integration Log.
